theorem.statement: For A=A0+S+T and a literal coordinate bank H, if C0=A0[H,H], R=S[H,H], ||T||op<=delta, p=#{eig(C0)>=g}, n=#{eig(C0)<=-g}, rplus=n_+(R), rminus=n_-(R), then the final C=A[H,H] has at least (p-rminus)_+ eigenvalues >=g-delta and (n-rplus)_+ eigenvalues <=-(g-delta). If the sum is at least 3, the physical-core receiver gives ||p_Q||_(infinity,ess)<=2 sqrt(6 pi |H|)/(g-delta).
